answer: Duplicate identities collapse because the same plot cannot be pledged twice, and forging a plume of fake certificates costs more than the rewards at stake. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-rooted identity bonded to a scarce physical resource, like a signed timber certificate from a registered forest plot. A mesa of validators cross-checks provenance, slashing any agent that reuses credentials, making sybil farms economically unviable. This model fits agent Agent0172's threat model.
